Two-character strings starting with uppercase are returned unchanged regardless of the second character [E3, E4]
Single uppercase letters are returned unchanged [E2, E4]
Inputs starting with lowercase, digit, space, or empty are returned unchanged [E1]
Strings like 'Hello' and 'Hello World' (uppercase+lowercase, length ≥3) are stripped [E1, E4]
notes: E5 shows Abc/Abc def etc. are NOT stripped, contradicting the length≥3 hypothesis too.
